subject: health
concept: Applying medicine safety, household product safety, adult-only product awareness, refusal skills, peer pressure recognition, and trusted-adult planning to a real-world scenario, using the student's interest profile
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.pictorial: Student works through a realistic scenario requiring a safe choice and a plan for telling a trusted adult
exercise.abstract: Student explains their response, referencing a specific safety concept from this unit

assessment.mastery_threshold: response reflects a genuinely safe choice and names a trusted adult to involve
misconception_flags: response handles the situation entirely alone with no trusted adult involved

interest_binding: scenario generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
